Fixed. Gravity and the shooter now work together: pressing G makes the page fall and pile up at the bottom again, and the shooter keeps working on the fallen pile.

**The cause:** gravity mode takes every visible thing on the page and lets it fall. That included the shooter's transparent drawing layer, which covers the whole screen. That layer landed on the floor like a screen-sized block and pushed everything else up off the top.

**The fix:** I changed one line in your gravity-mode mod. It now skips layers that are fixed in place and that clicks pass through, like the shooter's drawing layer and its score readout. Everything else falls as before.

**What I checked, with the shooter on:**
- After pressing G, 39 pieces fell, none ended up above the screen, and 38 piled in the bottom half.
- I fired at the fallen pile and blew up 10 words.
- Pressing G again put the page back, and R brought the words back.
- No errors came up, and a screenshot shows the pile at the bottom with the ship in front.

One more thing: the screenshot showed your rainbow-rave mod running too. I didn't touch it.
